controls: Current/future bad answers, prepared/active entry and evaluation negotiation; rejected entries write no attempts/receipts/decks/profile exposure; invalid publication writes no rewards/candidates/invitation finalization; valid decomposed originals, cached publication receipts and repaired-request retry retain their authority.
